entries.title: Job 15:1
segments: ¶And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 15:2
segments: Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind,

entries.title: Job 15:3
segments: Reasoning with unprofitable talk, and with speeches which do no good?

entries.title: Job 15:4
segments: Yea, thou makest piety of none effect, and restrainest meditation before *God.

entries.title: Job 15:5
segments: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou hast chosen the tongue of the crafty.

entries.title: Job 15:6
segments: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; and thy lips testify against thee.

entries.title: Job 15:7
segments: Art thou the first man that was born? and wast thou brought forth before the hills?

entries.title: Job 15:8
segments: Hast thou listened in the secret council of +God? And hast thou absorbed wisdom for thyself?

entries.title: Job 15:9
segments: What knowest thou that we know not? [what] understandest thou which is not in us?

entries.title: Job 15:10
segments: Both the greyheaded and the aged are with us, older than thy father.

entries.title: Job 15:11
segments: Are the consolations of *God too small for thee? and the word gently spoken to thee?

entries.title: Job 15:12
segments: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? and why do thine eyes wink?

entries.title: Job 15:13
segments: That thou turnest thy spirit against *God, and lettest words go out of thy mouth?

entries.title: Job 15:14
segments: What is man, that he should be pure? and he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

entries.title: Job 15:15
segments: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in his sight:

entries.title: Job 15:16
segments: How much less the abominable and corrupt, --man, that drinketh unrighteousness like water!

entries.title: Job 15:17
segments: ¶I will shew thee, listen to me; and what I have seen I will declare;

entries.title: Job 15:18
segments: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hidden;

entries.title: Job 15:19
segments: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

entries.title: Job 15:20
segments: All his days the wicked man is tormented, and numbered years are allotted to the violent.

entries.title: Job 15:21
segments: The sound of terrors is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer cometh upon him.

entries.title: Job 15:22
segments: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is singled out for the sword.

entries.title: Job 15:23
segments: He wandereth abroad for bread, --where may it be? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

entries.title: Job 15:24
segments: Distress and anguish make him afraid; they prevail against him, as a king ready for the battle.

entries.title: Job 15:25
segments: For he hath stretched out his hand against *God, and strengthened himself against the Almighty:

entries.title: Job 15:26
segments: He runneth against him, with [outstretched] neck, with the thick bosses of his bucklers;

entries.title: Job 15:27
segments: For he hath covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat upon [his] flanks.

entries.title: Job 15:28
segments: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, in houses that no man inhabiteth, which are destined to become heaps.

entries.title: Job 15:29
segments: He shall not become rich, neither shall his substance continue, and their possessions shall not extend upon the earth.

entries.title: Job 15:30
segments: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches; and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

entries.title: Job 15:31
segments: Let him not trust in vanity: he is deceived, for vanity shall be his recompense;

entries.title: Job 15:32
segments: It shall be complete before his day, and his branch shall not be green.

entries.title: Job 15:33
segments: He shall shake off his unripe grapes as a vine, and shall cast his flower as an olive.

entries.title: Job 15:34
segments: For the family of the ungodly shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

entries.title: Job 15:35
segments: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
